title: 8 Signs the Phone Owns More of a Godly Man Than Christ Does
caption:
Nobody hands their phone the throne on purpose. It happens one reflex at a time: the first-thing-in-the-morning check, the phantom buzz, the scroll that isn't really about the app.

Eight signs it's happened to you, and what it costs.

Save this and pick the one that stung.
